The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]] was '''invaded''' by the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] in [[3963 BBY]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]],<ref name="Atlas" /> following a number of [[Attacks on the Zabrak colonies|attacks]] on colonies of the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in the region.<ref name="Warfare" /> The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] held the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] for some [[Time/Legends|time]], recruiting some of the native Zabrak into their ranks, until the Republic [[Second battle of Iridonia (Mandalorian Wars)|liberated]] the planet.<ref name="Darkness" />
